correctness.evidence: Independent PSL(2,7) construction and enumeration gave 4032 product-one tuples in each of 12 position patterns (48384 total); maximal-subgroup reasoning shows all generate; independent Hurwitz BFS is one orbit of 48384; centerlessness gives free conjugation quotient of 288; degree-7 cycle types give genus 3; canonical lift sign split 24120/24264 and is not braid-invariant.

originality.evidence: Targeted searches and full-scope comparison with Fried arXiv:1803.10728, Seguin arXiv:2409.18246, Salih arXiv:2001.02295, and Khudhur 2021 DOI 10.24996/ijs.2021.62.2.25 found frameworks or other genus/group families but no exact (2A,3A,7A,7A) PSL(2,7) four-point braid-orbit census. Assessment is to the best of knowledge relative to checked sources.

value.evidence: The one-component result is a nontrivial global invariant of a natural four-point Hurwitz space, with reusable exact raw/reduced class sizes and a complete finite orbit certificate; it is not implied by classical three-point (2,3,7) generation.
